heroSection.subtitle: A factual reference for journalists, researchers, and others seeking information about the campaign and the case.

paragraphs.text: The Elephant In The Court Room is a Florida legal advocacy campaign documenting the Eclectic Synergy, LLC v. Seredin case, its history, available public records, and the ongoing legal effort.

This page provides a central reference point for journalists, researchers, and other interested parties who want to review information about the case and the materials available on the official campaign website.

paragraphs.text: The Elephant In The Court Room is a campaign website documenting the case and presenting information and materials connected to the campaign. It is not operated by, affiliated with, or endorsed by any court or government agency.
Journalists and researchers are encouraged to review the available source materials and public records when evaluating information concerning the case.
